method: Use all published blob entries under the eight requested prefixes, not the local Git index or status.
Read local bytes once and calculate Git blob SHA-1 using the Git blob header, SHA-256, byte count and local executable/symlink mode.
Check stat identity before and after each read.
Ignore docs/evidence and all other paths outside the explicit source prefixes. Unpublished generated/cache files are not part of the published tree comparison.
limits: This is a file identity check, not a test execution or a clean-tree claim.
No source was repaired, no workflow or GitHub state changed, and no tests were rerun.
Files outside the eight requested prefixes and unpublished files are outside this comparison.
Existing test success, Android performance and a new APK/Native visual receipt are not inferred from byte identity.
The published tree has no blob entries under android/ or integration_test/; these directories are explicitly counted as zero, not claimed to have been tested.
